name: com.invelon.mr-setup
description: Editor tool that switches the project's Android OpenXR feature set, Minimum API Level, and scripting define symbols between a Meta Quest passthrough configuration and a PICO passthrough configuration in a single step. Verifies the vendor OpenXR package (com.unity.xr.meta-openxr or com.unity.xr.openxr.picoxr) is installed before changing any setting, and aborts with a dialog listing exactly what's missing otherwise.
